prompt: I need you to create a comprehensive skill for building interactive web dashboards from CSV data. The skill should guide Claude through: 1) Reading CSV files and analyzing the data structure, 2) Generating HTML/CSS/JavaScript dashboards with charts and filters, 3) Including data validation and error handling, 4) Supporting multiple chart types (bar, line, pie), and 5) Making the dashboard responsive. The skill should be production-ready with proper documentation, examples, and bundled helper scripts. Name the skill 'dashboard-builder' and save it as dashboard-builder.skill when packaged.
